title: Influence of periodontitis treatment in insured persons according to §22a SGB V on periodontal health and oral microbiome in senior:inpatients: a randomized clinical trial in a waiting group design
summary:
In the course of this examination, the influence of the necessary periodontitis treatment determined for you by your dentist is to be examined. Since the summer of 2021, there have been special periodontitis treatment options in Germany that are tailored precisely to the circumstances and needs of people in inpatient care facilities like you.
How successful these new treatment routes are in terms of improving periodontitis has not yet been fully clarified in people in inpatient treatment and will be better investigated using the study conducted here. For this purpose, the parameters and the dental therapy steps that are performed on you will be documented and evaluated.
In addition, little is known about how the bacterial films found in the oral cavity present themselves, especially in seniors in inpatient care facilities. For this reason, bacteria are to be sampled at various points in the oral cavity, which may differ in terms of bacterial composition, at the examination appointments, and these bacteria are then examined in further detail. We hope that this will provide us with information on the composition prior to periodontitis treatment, but also on how this may change at the various sites in the oral cavity.
Patients in inpatient care facilities in particular are at high risk of developing pneumonia, and there is much debate in the research community as to whether this is related to oral health and the oral hygiene situation. Although it now seems clear that this is the case, very little is known about the extent to which periodontal therapy, such as the patients are receiving, alters the risk germs for pneumonia. Here, too, we hope that the present study will provide some insights.

interventions.name: Periodontal therapy according to §22a with direct start of therapy. A total of 4 appointments are planned. Baseline appointment, Follow up1, Follow up2, Follow up 3. At each of the appointments, a microbiome sample is taken and the teeth are cleaned or checked.

No direct intervention. The patients have microbiome samples taken for baseline therapy and then wait 3 months until their therapy can start with the baseline examination. Intervention group: Periodontal therapy according to §22a with immediate initiation of treatment. Following periodontal therapy, professional tooth brushing is performed daily by dental-trained personnel over a period of 3 months. In addition, interdental cleaning is provided where tolerated. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
need for periodontal treatment
Entitlement to periodontal therapy according to the instutional guideline PA-treatment section §22a
Resident:in a nursing home
no antiobiotic therapy in the last 6 months
no antibiotic therapy necessary for the performance of the PA treatment course
Exclusion criteria:
a life-threatening condition with imminent death of the resident, if the requirements of the health insurance company for participation in the PA treatment pathway according to §22a are not met (e.g. only anesthesia treatment possible)
